mentions.name: Queens Hourly
mentions.description: An hourly puzzle game app for iOS that publishes a new Queens-style logic puzzle (LinkedIn-style) every UTC hour, with all players worldwide solving the same puzzle for that hour. It has no leaderboards, stats, or in-app purchases—just pure play.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently launched Queens Hourly puzzle on App Store.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/queens-hourly/id6751763916

Every hour, new Queens Puzzle (LinkedIn style) is available to play. No leaderboard, no stats, nothing to buy, just pure play. Every user gets the exact same puzzle to solve for that UTC hour.
